svg.title: The battle screen's windows, labelled
svg.desc: A frame from the fight with Gato, captured from the rebuilt ROM, with four regions outlined. 1: the command window with Att., Tech and Item and the pointing-hand cursor. 2: the party members' names. 3: current HP and MP, as digit tiles. 4: the ATB gauges, four tiles each. Regions 2 to 4 are the status bar that BattleUI_BuildStatusBarFrame builds in a tilemap buffer at $7E:0CC0.
svg.text: Att. / Tech / Item; the hand is a sprite
digits by repeated subtraction, then tiles
